# We look forward to your visit

## Location

The main entrance to the Haggerty Museum of Art is located on the west side of the building facing into the Marquette University campus. The Museum is located directly north of the 13th Street and Clybourn Street intersection. From this location take a flight of stairs and slight hill to the front door. See Lot J directions below for an ADA compliant route.

[Google map showing location of the Haggerty Museum of Art and where to park.](https://www.google.com/maps/d/embed?mid=1Dwq0fasK_BbFE2YdcdmvIOf9gJU&hl=en)

## Parking

Several parking options are available to our visitors.

Expand all | Collapse all  

**Marquette’s Lot J - Free, limited availability**

Watch this [quick and helpful video](https://youtube.com/shorts/PgbG6kk-908?feature=share) to navigate your way to Lot J.

Limited free parking is available for Haggerty Museum of Art visitors during [regular hours](/haggerty-museum/hours.php) and [special events](/haggerty-museum/events.php).

ADA accessible. Please contact the museum for any special arrangements.

[Lot J is located at 601 N 11th St.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2iapsUgE1wfhBzcq9)

**Directions**  
Marquette University's Lot J can only be accessed by driving south on 11th Street (a one-way street) from the Wisconsin Avenue intersection.

A parking booth will become visible on your right, about halfway down the block. If an attendant is present, please inform them you are headed up to Lot J. If no attendant is in the booth, please proceed past the booth and drive up the hill to the next gated entry.

At Lot J, you may drive directly in if the gate is up. If the gate is down, please press the intercom button and inform the parking personnel that you are visiting the Haggerty Museum. Within the lot, parking is not allowed in spots marked “Gesu Parish Guests Only”.

Availability in this parking lot is not guaranteed at all times, especially during Gesu events.

**Street Parking Recommendations**

Street parking may be available at metered spaces on Clybourn Street, located between North 11th and 15th streets.

**Other Parking on Campus**

Additional parking is available in the Wells Street Parking Structure (1240 W. Wells St.), which is a short walk (~7 min/.3 mi) from the Haggerty Museum of Art.

## Hours

Monday through Saturday: 10 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Sunday: Closed

ADA Compliant. Please contact the museum for any special arrangements.

## Admission

The museum’s exhibitions and programs are free and open to the public, unless otherwise noted.

### The Museum is closed on the following days, following Marquette University’s holiday schedule:

- Martin Luther King, Jr. Day
- Good Friday
- Easter Sunday
- Memorial Day
- The week of Independence Day (dates vary year to year)
- Labor Day
- Thanksgiving Day, and the day after
- The week of Christmas Eve through New Year’s (dates vary year to year)
